items.title: Applied Materials (AMAT) Stock May Look Reasonable Following Fresh AI Demand Forecasts
items.summary: Applied Materials has seen its share price move sharply over the past few years, which puts fresh attention on whether the current valuation is backed up by the earnings power of the business. With the stock now in focus after a long run and steady headlines about AI related demand, the key issue is how much of that story is already reflected in the price.
